# Fitting search

These are normal Go `/fits/search` (unselected and Rifter-selected) and results,
more, profiles and popular fragments. A local in-process HTTP stub supplied two
roles, one hull, one result per controlled page and DPS buckets. Result offsets
are 0/24 with the matching metadata; the first advertises more. No database or
production data was changed. The temporary capture test was removed. Tests keep
Go JSON seeds and strip executable scripts/styles before mounting the scopes.
